The number of neurons, connection probability, and spectral radius jointly shape the trade-off between computational cost, accuracy, and energy efficiency. We optimize these parameters later through the proposed adaptive learning framework. To enhance temporal abstraction, the reservoir outputs are passed to Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) that, in this paper, serves as the trainable readout.
